reason: A client-side visualization plugin that renders conversation trajectory events, including messages, tool activity, and turn transitions, as a configurable danmaku overlay.

summaries.zh: 将对话轨迹中的消息、工具调用和轮次事件以可调节的弹幕叠加层实时显示在页面上。
summaries.en: Displays conversation trajectory events such as messages, tool calls, and turn transitions as a configurable real-time danmaku overlay.

capabilities: Displays conversation trajectory events as a danmaku overlay
Reads user, assistant, tool, and turn events from the conversation view
Persists display settings and overlay position in localStorage
Provides draggable controls for enabling the overlay and adjusting animation speed
